title.narrative: The 14th Biennial Conference of Network of African National Human Rights

description.narrative: The main actitivity is a Conference which will be held for three days on October 18 - 20, 2023 physically in Accra Ghana, co-hosted by the NANHRI Secretariat and the Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice (CHRAJ). The meeting will be characterised by an opening session, expert presentations, panel discussions, plenaries and parallel meetings, from the 46 African NHRIs, civil society organisations, governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental organisations, the UN agencies, thematic experts, the private sector (business communities) representatives, the academia, select representatives of vulnerable populations and development partners
